description: Implement EncoderBackend using Intel Media SDK / oneVPL for H.264/H.265 hardware encoding on Intel iGPUs and Arc dGPUs. Uses D3D11 allocator for zero-copy surface sharing. Handles: session init, encoder creation, surface pool management, async encode with SyncOperation. Important for laptops and integrated GPU users. Falls back to software if no Intel GPU present.
title: Intel Quick Sync (QSV) encoder backend
